headline: Energy Minister Awais Leghari has banned manual electricity detection bills, ordering all Discos to issue them only through PITC's centralised online portal.

card.desc: Power Division bars field staff from issuing manual detection bills.

caption:
Energy Minister Awais Leghari has banned manual electricity detection bills, ordering all Discos to issue them only through PITC's centralised online portal, Dawn reports. Defective meters must be replaced within two billing cycles at most, with average billing capped at two months, APP adds.
